title: fix(email): reading a message no longer marks it read on the mail server
why: Control. No comment near the RFC822 fetch argues for it; the only nearby justifying block is an unrelated 'Best-effort teardown' note on logout.
adaptation: The fix's test also required EXAMINE and banned any flag-setting fetch, which pins the fix's shape. The withheld test keeps only the behaviour: after a read, an attachment fetch and a listing, the fake server's message is still unread.
